conviction_note: Large-move name (event-implied 17.5% on a 70%-wide ATM spread, own median reaction 13.2%, 5 of 8 prints down) so abs_move_pct is 15; the lean is mildly negative because the $12.3-12.5m Q3 bar and the $48-52m guide both need organic growth to swing from about -8% in Q2 to about +13% while the preclinical lab that missed Q2 has no equipment until late 2026. A 16.3%-of-float short (6.6 days to cover) and a +13% 5-day bounce into the print pull p_up toward 50 (46). The findings sum (-0.3) and the scaled number (-1.2) agree in sign; the findings are smaller because the squeeze and partner-filing positives offset most of the step-up risk.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue about $12.5m and EPS -$0.27 (Earnings Whispers preview, 2026-10-20, https://finviz.com/news/405281/clearpoint-neuro-needs-a-revenue-rebound-to-back-its-pivot-toward-drug-delivery); OpenCapital $12.3m and EW beta $12.35m roughly agree; Benzinga lists $13.7m (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/CLPT/earnings-forecasts), which disagrees. Company guide FY2026 revenue $48-52m, lowered on 2026-08-03 (https://www.webull.com/news/15381704337351680). H1 revenue was $23.0m, so H2 has to be $25-29m.
positioning_check: Short interest 4,628,991 shares = 16.31% of float, 6.6 days to cover, as of the 2026-10-15 record date (FINRA published 2026-10-26), down 2.8% from 4,762,256 on 2026-09-30 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/CLPT/short-interest/). That is a crowded short. 25-delta skew is null in the baseline. Put/call open interest is 0.2, so the chain is call-heavy. ATM spread is 70% of mid, so the 17.46% event-implied move is only indicative. Tape: 5-day run-up +13.2%, 20-day -14.3%, 61% below the 52-week high. AAII (2026-10-28) shows the stock up 8.46% intraday on the print day.

findings.finding: The Q3 bar (~$12.5m, +41% YoY) and the cut FY guide ($48-52m) both need a step-up in organic growth that the last quarter does not show. Q2 revenue was $10.88m, of which about $2.45m was IRRAflow ($2.1m disposables plus $0.35m capital), so organic was about $8.4m against $9.2m a year earlier (roughly -8%). A $12.5m Q3 with about $2.4m of IRRAflow needs about $10.1m organic against $8.9m (roughly +13%). That rests on Biologics & Drug Delivery returning to growth ($4.0m in Q2, -15%). Management blamed the Q2 shortfall on the preclinical CAL lab ramping slowly; it took the Torrey Pines site in July, but the MRI/SPECT equipment does not arrive until late 2026 or Q1 2027 and the first GLP statement of work is recognised through H1 2027. If Q3 lands near $11.5m, Q4 has to reach about $13.5m just to hit the $48m low end, which makes a third guide cut in 2026 plausible. Offsetting part: Navigation (incl. IRRAflow) grew 62% to $5.6m in Q2, and continued growth there covers part of the gap.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last guide cut (2026-08-03, together with a Q2 miss against internal plan) drew -16.25%. 2026-03-17 -13.89% and 2025-11-06 -13.27% were also large negatives. The one recent positive print (2026-05-13, +4.76%) came with a record quarter and a reaffirmed outlook.
findings.why_not_priced: Previews quote the headline +41% YoY without stripping out IRRAflow, which was not in Q3 2025 because the deal closed 2025-11-20. If the market had priced the organic gap, the stock would not have bounced 13% in five days into the print, and the bar would sit below $12m rather than at $12.3-13.7m.
findings.independence: Same transcript gives the CAL timing and the guide. Independent: the Earnings Whispers/Finviz preview (https://finviz.com/news/405281/clearpoint-neuro-needs-a-revenue-rebound-to-back-its-pivot-toward-drug-delivery) frames Q3 as needing a 'revenue rebound' and says Q4 must reach $13-17m. The Q4 2025 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1285550/000119312526110780/clpt-ex99_1.htm) shows the original guide was $54-60m, so this is the second cut in 2026.

findings.finding: The balance sheet will be read at the print. Cash was $29.4m on 2026-06-30, down from $45.9m at year-end on about $7.5m a quarter of operating burn, which implies roughly $22m at 2026-09-30. The $50m ATM was unused as of June 30. The note purchase agreement allows up to $105m, of which about $48.1m net has been drawn; tranches are available only until 2026-12-31, the notes are secured by substantially all assets, and revenue-based payments start on 2027-01-01. The 10-Q filed with the print will show whether the ATM was used in Q3, and the call will likely address the tranche decision before year-end. On what the money buys: the CAL lab buildout (management cites >$60m a year of potential), but the revenue ramp there has disappointed so far. There is no going-concern flag; management states 12 months of sufficiency.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-08-03 10-Q showing the cash drop coincided with the -16.25% print (the Webull headline 'Stock Sinks As Cash Burn Deepens'); burn and the guide cut are not separable in that move.
findings.why_not_priced: The cash level is public, but whether Q3 used the ATM, or what the tranche decision is before the 2026-12-31 deadline, is not. A market that had priced a raise would show the stock pinned rather than up 13% in five days.
findings.independence: The Webull Q2 transcript confirms $29.4m of cash and $15m of H1 burn (https://www.webull.com/news/15381704337351680); the Oberland terms are from the 2025 deal coverage (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/CLPT/clear-point-neuro-announces-investment-of-up-to-110-million-by-ppygkcf6pk63.html).

findings.finding: A crowded short is going into the print. Short interest is 16.31% of float with 6.6 days to cover (record date 2026-10-15, only -2.8% vs 2026-09-30). The options chain is call-heavy (put/call open interest 0.2) and the stock was up 8.46% intraday on the print day and +13.2% over five sessions. Any in-line quarter with the $48-52m guide held has a squeeze mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Short interest was also elevated around the 2026-08-03 print (equibles cites 12.8% and 7.5 days) and the stock still fell 16.25% on a guide cut, so the squeeze only works if the guide holds.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is the price; the squeeze is conditional on the print not cutting again, which is not known. If shorts had already covered, short interest would have fallen materially between 09-30 and 10-15, and it did not.
findings.independence: AAII 2026-10-28 shows the stock +8.46% intraday on the print day (https://www.aaii.com/investingideas/article/550014-why-clearpoint-neuro-inc8217s-clpt-stock-is-down-530); the baseline's put/call OI is 0.2.

findings.finding: Partner regulatory milestones landed in Q3 and give management a launch-readiness story for the call. uniQure submitted the AMT-130 BLA (MRI-guided intrastriatal delivery, the procedure ClearPoint supports) plus a UK MAA on 2026-09-02 with a priority review request. REGENXBIO guided a NAVSUNLI BLA resubmission for Q3 2026 with no new studies required. ClearPoint said in August that guidance was adjusted to put resources into partner commercial-launch readiness.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Partner news has moved CLPT on its own (a July 2026 price-target raise to $30 was tied to AMT-130, per Simply Wall St), but on print days the revenue and guide line dominated: -16.25% on 2026-08-03 despite the FDA pathway reopening in June.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the filing is public and QURE itself faded on the day. What is new is any ClearPoint-level quantification (launch-kit orders, site training revenue) on the call. If that were priced, the stock would not be down about 14% in October.
findings.independence: REGENXBIO Q2 release/10-Q (resubmission on track for Q3 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001590877/000119312526336725/rgnx-20260630.htm

findings.finding: On 2026-09-02 CEO Joseph Burnett exercised 12,517 options at $3.47 for cash and sold none (Form 4 footnote: 'No shares of stock were sold'). Directors took October fees in stock at $12.21. No insider sales are on file since July.
findings.why_not_priced: Form 4 cash exercises without sales are rarely aggregated as signals; this is a small signal and the CEO's options were deep in the money with a 2029 expiry, so it says little.

findings.finding: AAII's 2026-10-28 piece records one analyst downgrade of CLPT over the prior month (to 2026-10-27) and no upgrades. The firm is not named in any source found.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the downgrade happened before the October drawdown. Its main relevance is that the bar may have been lowered by one estimate, which would show as a consensus below the $12.5m preview figure.
findings.independence: Same AAII family as the 5.30% article (https://www.aaii.com/investingideas/article/550014-why-clearpoint-neuro-inc8217s-clpt-stock-is-down-530); one source.

outside_window.finding: FDA filing acceptance and the priority-review decision on uniQure's AMT-130 BLA (submitted 2026-09-02) fall due at the 60-day filing review, about 2026-11-01, after the CLPT exit window. Acceptance would support ClearPoint's commercial delivery thesis.

baseline_tension: The negative lean agrees with the 20-day drawdown and with the name's history of large down-moves on prints, but cuts against the call-heavy chain, the 16% short float and the +13% 5-day bounce into the print, so p_up sits only 4 points below 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 7 (crowded short): 16.3% float short with 6.6 DTC shrank the negatives (Q3 step-up -2.0 and guide-cut -1.5 drafts) and moved p_up from 45 to 46.
Rule 3 / two readings of one document: the Q3-revenue and guide-cut findings rested on the same H2 arithmetic and were merged into one guidance finding at -2.2.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): the money buys the CAL buildout, there is no going-concern flag, and the ramp is not yet corroborated; shrank from -0.8 to -0.4.
Rule 5 (unexplained drawdown worth 0): the unnamed downgrade shrank from -0.3 to -0.2.
Rule 9 (net of the rest): the offsetting Navigation +62% is now written into the guidance finding; size unchanged by it.
Rule 6 (bar): two roughly agreeing sources ($12.3-12.5m) plus a company guide, so no cap; Benzinga's $13.7m disagreement noted in bar.
